fed.note_en: October watch. PM exclusive +25bp mid 0.245 vs Altınla CME-method hike-bin 0.31 (gap 6.5pp) — mismatch_flag false (<~8–10pp). Buying the whole NegRisk set costs 1.0324 after 5% fees — no edge. September FOMC resolved +25bp; prior mismatch retired. Primary = Altınla (bins_sane); Investing now matches Altınla hike=0.31 / FrenzyCap hike=0.24 / ZQ day-weight ≈0.217 all sub-threshold vs PM.
fed.note_zh: 十月观察。PM 独家 +25bp mid 0.245 对 Altınla CME 方法加息档 0.31（缺口 6.5 个百分点）——错配标记 false（<约 8–10pp）。整组 NegRisk 扣 5% 费后成本 1.0324，无边。九月 FOMC 已公布 +25bp。主源 Altınla（bins_sane）；Investing 现已与 Altınla 一致加息档 0.31 / FrenzyCap 0.24 / ZQ 日权重大约 0.217 对 PM 均低于门槛。
fed.recheck_en: Re-check if: (1) contracts are definition-matched, AND (2) NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule, AND (3) the expensive legs still have size, OR |PM−CME gap| ≥ ~8–10pp on matched bins.
fed.recheck_zh: 重检条件：定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的那几条仍有深度；或对齐档上 |PM−CME| 缺口 ≥ 约 8–10 个百分点。

scan.count_rule_zh: 817 = 806 个 Yes/No 盘 + 11 个 NegRisk 事件。全集在 universe.json。

method.en: Audit, not a teaser. Scan exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks; reject any incomplete partition; apply that market’s feeSchedule.rate (fee = C × rate × p × (1−p); rebate ignored). A Fed gap counts only if contracts are definition-matched. Scorecards freeze T−2h modal Yes mid vs BLS first print. Book / fill depth is unverified. Engine stays private; every number on this page is in desk.json.
method.zh: 这是审计，不是预告页。扫互斥 NegRisk 的 Yes 卖一；分区不完整就否；用该市场 feeSchedule.rate（fee = C × rate × p × (1−p)，忽略返佣）。利率缺口只在定义对齐时才算。记分卡用 T−2h 众数 Yes mid 对 BLS 首次。盘口/成交深度未核验。引擎不公开；这页每个数都在 desk.json。

history_policy.en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). Later snapshots on 14–16 Sep are additional public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. Sep NFP public pre_print freeze ship_id remains 2026-10-01-1051 (commit c416920; forced while <48h to print). This afternoon ship (2026-10-02-1643) is a scan refresh only — freeze row prices stay locked from the morning freeze.
history_policy.zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 的后续快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的追加事前公开冻结。9 月非农公开事前冻盘 ship_id 仍为 2026-10-01-1051（commit c416920；距公布 <48h 强制上船）。本下午船 (2026-10-02-1643) 仅为扫描刷新——冻盘行价格保持上午锁定不变。
